findings.claim: The archive mount is stale on absent device 8:3 while the same Seagate disk reappeared as /dev/sdb3, device 8:19.
findings.source: gc-05 findmnt, mountinfo, lsblk, udevadm, blkid, and sysfs inspection

findings.claim: The persistent archive identity is usb-Seagate_Expansion_HDD_00000000NT197WLC-0:0-part3 with ext4 UUID 96c09eae-57cb-4e5c-95e1-9050a32abcc4.
Immediate read-write remount is unsafe because the filesystem reports needs_recovery and orphan_present; stale namespaces must first be cleared and an offline read-only e2fsck performed.
findings.source: gc-05 tune2fs, findmnt, namespace, and process-reference inspection

findings.claim: One controlled video 4 recovery likely fits local NVMe capacity, but no concurrent import or reconciliation is safe until verified obsolete temporary data is cleaned.
findings.source: gc-05 df, btrfs usage, du, and active FFmpeg observations

gaps: Full physical-disk SMART telemetry is unavailable through the USB bridge.
Filesystem repair and persistent mount configuration remain separate post-import operational work.
